agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: ReindentFilter._get_offset used raw.splitlines()[-2] which raised IndexError when the accumulated raw text before a token had no newline yet (single-line splitlines result), e.g. for parenthesis, WHERE, identifier list, CASE, VALUES processing. Changed index to [-1] to correctly reference the current/last line. Verified via manual sqlparse.format(..., reindent=True) calls covering parenthesis grouping, WHERE/AND clauses, plain column lists, CASE expressions, and VALUES clauses — all produce correct output with no errors.
